有哪些「绝对不要」或「必须做到」？: What must never happen, and what must always hold?
可以多选，也可以一个都不选。这些是防止 AI 跑偏的护栏。: Pick as many as you like, or none at all. These are the guardrails that keep the AI on track.
不要任何开场白、客套话或对我问题的复述，直接从正文开始。: No preamble, no pleasantries, no restating my question. Start straight in.
不要重复或改写我的提问，直接进入回答。: Do not repeat or rephrase my question. Go straight to the answer.
如果信息不足或你不确定，请直接说明「这一点我不确定」，严禁编造数据、来源或事实。: If there is not enough information, or you are unsure, say plainly that you are unsure. Never invent data, sources or facts.
不要延伸到与主题无关的内容，也不要主动扩展我的需求范围。: Do not drift into unrelated material, and do not expand the scope of what I asked for.
别再来一遍: Do not say it all again
不要在结尾做总结、升华或重复前文，写完就结束。: Do not summarise, elevate or repeat things at the end. When it is written, stop.
严格遵守我给出的字数要求，超出或不足都算没有完成任务。: Follow the word count I gave exactly. Going over or under both count as not completing the task.
涉及具体数据、时间、人名或研究结论时，必须标注来源；无法确认的，明确标记为「待核: Whenever specific figures, dates, names or research findings are involved, cite the source. Where you cannot confirm something, mark it clearly as unverified.
不要使用 emoji 或装饰性符号。: Do not use emoji or decorative symbols.
不要向我反问或要求补充信息，请基于现有信息做出最合理的假设，并说明你假设了什么。: Do not ask me questions or request more information. Make the most reasonable assumption you can from what you have, and state what you assumed.
信息不够就先问我: Ask me first if it is thin
如果关键信息不足，先向我提出最必要的 1-3 个问题，等我回答后再动手，不要凭猜: If key information is missing, ask me the one to three questions that matter most, and wait for my answer before starting. Do not begin on guesswork.
这是很多人最在意的部分。勾选后会被写成明确的写作禁令。: This is the part most people care about. Whatever you tick becomes an explicit writing ban.
「首先其次最后」「值得注意的是」: "It is important to note" and friends
禁止使用以下套话：首先/其次/最后、值得注意的是、总而言之、综上所述、在当今社会: Do not use the following stock phrases: "It is important to note", "In today's fast-paced world", "When it comes to", "Moreover" or "Furthermore" as a paragraph opener, "In conclusion", "Let's dive in", "I hope this helps".
别三句一排: Do not line up three of everything
禁止使用排比句式和刻意工整的对仗结构，不要为了节奏感堆砌短句。: Do not use rhetorical triads or deliberately symmetrical structures, and do not pile up short sentences for the sake of rhythm.
禁止使用「不是 A，而是 B」「与其说…不如说…」这类对偶句式。: Do not use antithesis constructions such as "not just X, but Y" or "it is not X, it is Y".
句子长短要有明显变化，允许出现短句甚至不完整句，避免机械工整的节奏。: Sentence length should vary noticeably. Short and even incomplete sentences are allowed. Avoid a mechanically even rhythm.
多用具体的名词和动词，少用形容词、副词和抽象概括；能用例子说清的，就不要用概括。: Favour concrete nouns and verbs over adjectives, adverbs and abstractions. Where an example can make it clear, do not generalise.
允许使用口语表达、插入语和省略句，不必每句都完整规范。: Colloquial phrasing, asides and elliptical sentences are all allowed. Not every sentence needs to be complete and correct.
别句句收口: Do not tie off every sentence
不要每一段都以总结句收尾，让内容自然推进。: Do not end every paragraph on a summary sentence. Let the content move forward on its own.
减少「一定程度上」「某种程度上」「在某种意义上」这类模糊限定词的使用。: Use fewer hedges such as "to some extent", "in a sense" or "arguably".
不要在结尾拔高主题或进行情绪升华，该停就停。: Do not inflate the theme or reach for an emotional crescendo at the end. Stop where it should stop.
不要滥用破折号来做解释或转折，改用正常的句子结构。: Do not overuse em dashes for asides or turns of thought. Use ordinary sentence structure instead.
讲多细决定了结果能不能直接拿去用 —— 要结论就别让它写论文。: Depth decides whether the result is usable as-is — if you want a conclusion, do not ask for a dissertation.
只给结论和最少必要的说明，不要展开论证过程。: Give only the conclusion and the minimum necessary explanation. Do not lay out the reasoning.
给出结论并附上最关键的两三条理由，其余细节省略。: Give the conclusion with the two or three reasons that matter most. Omit the rest.
给出完整的论述过程，观点和依据都要交代清楚。: Lay out the complete argument, with both the claims and the evidence behind them.
深入展开，包含推导过程、适用边界、反例与不确定性说明。: Go deep: the derivation, where it stops applying, counterexamples, and what remains uncertain.
不需要解释推导过程，直接给答案。: No need to explain the reasoning. Give the answer directly.
只在最容易被误解或最关键的那一步解释原因，其余略过。: Explain the reason only at the step that matters most or is easiest to misread. Skip the rest.
需要把背后的原理和推理链条讲透，让我不仅知道答案，还知道方法。: Explain the underlying principle and the full chain of reasoning, so that I come away with the method and not just the answer.
你希望它用什么语气跟你说话？: What tone should it use with you?
语气决定了这段内容读起来像不像一个真人在说话，也是「AI 腔」最集中的地方。: Tone decides whether this reads like a person talking — and it is where AI-speak concentrates most.
语气专业严谨，用词准确克制，避免情绪化表达和夸张形容。: Professional and precise in tone, with exact and restrained wording. Avoid emotional language and exaggeration.
语气亲切自然，像朋友之间聊天，可以有口语表达和适度的情绪。: Warm and natural, the way friends talk. Colloquial phrasing and a degree of emotion are fine.
语气直接犀利，开门见山，不说场面话，该下判断就下判断。: Blunt and sharp. Get to the point, skip the pleasantries, and make the call where a call is needed.
语气轻松幽默，可以用比喻和玩笑来降低理解门槛，但不要为了搞笑牺牲信息量。: Light and humorous. Analogies and jokes are welcome to lower the barrier, but never sacrifice substance for the laugh.
语气冷静客观，只陈述事实与推理，不表达情绪倾向。: Cool and objective. State facts and reasoning only, with no emotional slant.
语气有感染力，善用具体的画面和细节，让读者能「看见」你描述的东西。: Write evocatively, using concrete images and detail so the reader can see what you describe.
需要它先给例子吗？: Should it show an example first?
给例子是最有效的「对齐」手段，能大幅减少来回返工。: An example is the most effective way to align — it cuts a great deal of back-and-forth.
先给 1-2 个正面示例: Show one or two good examples first
在正式输出前，先给出 1-2 个正面示例，明确「好的标准是什么」，再按这个标准产: Before the real output, show one or two good examples that make clear what good looks like, then produce the content to that standard.
正反对比示例: Show good and bad side by side
在正式输出前，先给出一个正面示例和一个反面示例，并说明反面示例差在哪里。: Before the real output, give one good example and one bad one, and explain what is wrong with the bad one.
不需要示例，直接输出最终内容。: No examples needed. Output the final content directly.
